newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam woman dies in flames after marital row.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam woman dies in flames after marital row.

text.p: A Vietnamese woman committed suicide last week by setting herself on fire after quarrelling with her drunken husband, an official in Ho Chi Minh City said on Friday.
The 37-year-old woman, whose name was given as Thanh, was taken to hospital on March 15 after pouring kerosene on her body and setting it alight, but died of her injuries the next day.
The official said the husband and wife had argued many times in the past over his habit of staying out late and drinking.
